cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 chassis. Defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @3 with prominent buffers Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine @4, Coco-Glucoside @7 and Cocamidopropyl Betaine @17; no reinforcing strong anionic.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful system (cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @14) with light routes Glycol Distearate @16 (pearlizer), Hydrolyzed Keratin @12 (protein) and humectants Glycerin @5, Panthenol @11, Hydrogenated Starch Hydrolysate @2. C2 not met: no early silicone or payload lipid. Counter-signal: the guar and keratin sit after several typically low-dose actives (allantoin, bisabolol, zinc PCA, panthenol), so light care (low) is realistic.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Guar and keratin behind low-dose actives; light care (low) realistic.
